context: A walkthrough script for PR #42 with an intent scene (title card), a change scene (diff containing braces and a literal backslash-n), an implications scene (points) and a validation scene whose claims are one shown (with a receipt containing a pipe), one unchecked and one intended. ffmpeg with libass is on PATH; piper may not be.
expected_behavior: check exits 0 and reports ok for the well-formed script
A shown claim without a receipt exits 2 and tells the author to add a receipt or mark it intended or unchecked
An unknown claim status, a missing validation scene, or scenes out of intent → change → implications → validation order exit 2 with a message naming the rule
A code or diff visual taller or wider than the slide exits 2 and states how many lines or columns fit
A missing image or video file exits 2 and names the path
Backticks in narration produce a warning, not an error
--tts piper with no piper binary or voice exits 3 and says how to install piper; auto falls back to say, espeak-ng, then captions-only and says so
render --tts none writes a 1920x1080 walkthrough.mp4 with an audio track, captions.srt, transcript.md and manifest.json, and removes its work directory
transcript.md lists every claim with its status and receipt, escaping pipes so the markdown table holds
failure_modes: A claim marked shown renders without any receipt behind it
Braces or backslashes in code are swallowed as libass override tags
Falling back to a silent video without saying so
Leaving per-scene intermediates behind in the output directory
